title: Evaluation review desk
subtitle: Fictional demo records. Saved results require a current evidence check before approval.

sections.title: Runs and coverage
sections.sql: select name,model_version,expected_cases,observed_cases,passed,failed,decision,evidence_state,review_due from run_summary order by review_due,name

sections.title: Actions to resolve
sections.sql: select run,title,owner,due,days_overdue from action_queue where status='open' order by due,id

sections.title: Evidence controls
